Part 5 of 5 of the Oxygen Destroyer, from the military site by Ashmouth. Combine all five at a workbench.
Holds a part of the Oxygen Destroyer.
Place it in Ashmouth or on the shore in front of it, where he comes out of the sea, and arm it. If Godzilla comes within 100 m of it, he dies.
We must find a way to stop Godzilla! Head east along the road through the forest. The army had a post outside Cedar Harbor, at the far end of it. If anything can help us, it's there.\n\nThe Duke

Part one of the Oxygen Destroyer, recovered. Unit two pulled back with the next part: go north through the mountain pass beside Cedar Harbor into the burnt forest, then follow the road west to Cinder Bay on the coast. Their post is just outside the city.
Part two recovered. The desert unit has the third part: north through the pass beside Cinder Bay, then east along the road to Dune Point. Look for the army post outside the city.
Part three recovered. The fourth went north with the mountain unit: through the pass beside Dune Point into the snow, then west to Frostport. They dug in outside the city.

Part four recovered. The last part, the Oxygen Core, is locked in the fortified military site outside Ashmouth: north through the pass beside Frostport into the wasteland, then east to the coast. It will be heavily guarded.

That is every part. Build the Oxygen Destroyer at a workbench (with 10 electrical parts and 20 forged steel), place it on the shore in front of Ashmouth where he comes out of the sea, and arm it before the last blood moon ends. If he comes within 100 m of it, he dies.
